claims.claim: Tranzila API V2 authentication is a 4-header HMAC-SHA256 handshake: X-tranzila-api-app-key (public key), X-tranzila-api-request-time (unix seconds), X-tranzila-api-nonce (~40 bytes), X-tranzila-api-access-token (HMAC-SHA256 of the app key keyed with secret+request_time+nonce). Base URL is api.tranzila.com/v1; a single-header request is rejected.
claims.raw_snippet:
X-tranzila-api-app-key	Application key supplied by Tranzila
X-tranzila-api-request-time	Request time sent in Unix format (large integer counting seconds from Jan 1 st , 1970 00:00:00
X-tranzila-api-nonce	A 40 bytes NONCE – unique random string generated with any random bytes function
X-tranzila-api-access-token	hash_hmac using ‘sha256’ on application key with secret + request-time + nonce.
claims.verified_via: fetched and read the cited page on 2026-08-09

claims.claim: Tranzila Bit is a dedicated API (Bit Init / Bit Refund endpoints under api.tranzila.com/v1 with the 4-header HMAC auth), not a bit=1 flag on the card CGI.
